| T-ACTIVE-MATTER | [Active matter](active-matter.md) | the paper studies self-propelled particles, swimming bacteria or cells, catalytic or light-driven active colloids, or motor-driven active gels and nematics, and bases a claim on propulsion speed or mechanism, wall accumulation, clustering, density or order parameters, or a collective phase |
| CL-NONLINEAR-DYNAMICS | [Claims of chaos and pattern formation](nonlinear-dynamics.md) | the paper claims that a system is chaotic or follows low-dimensional deterministic dynamics, reports a Lyapunov exponent, fractal or correlation dimension from measured data, identifies a bifurcation or route to chaos, or attributes a spatial pattern to a stated instability |
| T-COLLOIDS | [Colloidal systems](colloids.md) | the paper uses model colloidal particles, such as PMMA, polystyrene, silica or microgel spheres, and bases a claim on their volume fraction, interactions, phase behaviour, structure or dynamics, or on particle coordinates from confocal or video microscopy |
| T-FOAMS-EMULSIONS | [Foams and emulsions](foams-emulsions.md) | the paper reports experiments on liquid foams or emulsions and bases a claim on bubble or droplet sizes, coarsening, coalescence, drainage, liquid or dispersed-phase fraction, the role of a surfactant or stabiliser, rheology near jamming, or three-dimensional images of foam structure |
| T-GLASS-TRANSITION | [Glass transition and dynamic heterogeneity](glass-transition.md) | the paper reports a glass transition temperature or volume fraction, relaxation times of supercooled liquids, colloidal glasses or jammed packings, fragility or a divergence from fits, ageing, dynamic heterogeneity or a dynamic length scale, or confinement or finite-size effects on glassy dynamics |
| T-GRANULAR-MATERIALS | [Granular materials](granular-materials.md) | the paper reports experiments on packings or flows of macroscopic grains, such as beads, disks or sand, that are tapped, vibrated, sheared or compressed, or bases a claim on packing fraction, photoelastic forces, a granular or effective temperature, or discrete-element simulations |
| T-LIQUID-CRYSTALS | [Liquid crystals](liquid-crystals.md) | the paper studies nematic, smectic, cholesteric or other liquid-crystal phases, identifies a mesophase by polarised microscopy, X-ray scattering or calorimetry, prepares aligned cells, measures anchoring, elastic constants, viscosities or field-induced switching, characterises a phase transition, or interprets defect textures |
| T-MICROFLUIDICS | [Microfluidics](microfluidics.md) | the paper reports flows, transport, droplets, particles, cells or reactions in microfluidic or nanofluidic channels, including polydimethylsiloxane or other polymer devices, pressure- or electrokinetically driven flow, or bases a claim on slip, surface charge or behaviour that depends on channel size |
| T-MICRORHEOLOGY | [Particle tracking and microrheology](microrheology.md) | the paper tracks tracer particles by video microscopy, reports mean-squared displacements, diffusion coefficients or anomalous exponents, or infers viscosity, viscoelastic moduli or heterogeneity of a soft or biological material from passive or active microrheology, including optical or magnetic tweezers |
| T-POLYMERS | [Polymer experiments](polymers.md) | the paper reports experiments on polymer solutions, melts, networks or gels, quotes molar mass, dispersity, a concentration regime, solvent quality, a degree of crystallinity or a gel point, or assigns a scaling exponent to polymer data |
| T-RHEOLOGY | [Rheology](rheology.md) | the paper reports viscosity, flow curves, yield stress, storage and loss moduli, normal stress differences or extensional viscosity of a complex fluid or soft solid measured with a rheometer, or bases a claim about flow, elasticity, yielding, thixotropy or ageing on them |
| T-SOFT-MATTER-SCATTERING | [Scattering from soft matter](soft-matter-scattering.md) | the paper uses dynamic or static light scattering, small-angle X-ray scattering or small-angle neutron scattering on colloids, polymers, micelles, vesicles or proteins in solution, melts or gels to claim a size, size distribution, molar mass, shape, internal structure, aggregation state or interaction |
| T-TURBULENCE-MEASUREMENT | [Turbulence measurement](turbulence-measurement.md) | the paper measures a turbulent flow with particle image velocimetry, particle tracking, laser Doppler or hot-wire anemometry, or reports turbulence spectra, structure functions, dissipation rates, scaling exponents, acceleration statistics or a turbulence Reynolds number from such data |
